description: Generic escape hatch: fetch records from ANY data.regionreunion.com dataset with a raw ODSQL where clause. Call reunion_inspect_dataset first to know the fields. ODSQL supports operators like =, !=, >, <, LIKE, AND, OR, and the search() function.

select.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return (defaults to all)

where.description: ODSQL where clause, e.g. "commune = 'Saint-Denis' AND annee > 2020"

name: reunion_query_dataset
